facts.event: 三人同车离开 Nandenys，Gundobar 刻意绕过 Ardwen 的贸易城镇，夜里锁门睡在马车里、开舱迎雨。
facts.relation: Tilde 与侍女 Marolyn、表亲 Hadiah 同行，Gundobar 是押送的 Galenish 领主。
facts.anchor: It carried the three of us away from Nandenys, through the shadowed valleys of the hills.

facts.event: 抵达森林关卡：Liran 每夺一处氏族地便筑铁石堡垒，Ardwen 关前立起两座新凿石灰岩塔，挂暴君的天鹅结；Merogian 商贩的货车被翻、衣服被撕、通行证被毁。
facts.relation: 关卡由 Galenish 守军把守；被拦下的多是 Merogian（Ardweni），Cynghal、Galenish 与少数东方商人可通行。
facts.numbers: two towers of fresh cut limestone
facts.anchor: Their carts had been ransacked, their clothes torn; one man’s barley grain was still spilling

facts.event: Marolyn 跳下车顶查看，回报一棵树倒在路上——hannerast 上树从不自倒，三人疑为凶兆。
facts.relation: Marolyn 是 Tilde 的贴身侍女兼护卫，Hadiah 是通晓宫廷礼节的表亲。
facts.anchor: ‘A tree has fallen on the road.’

facts.event: Tilde 被林声吸引，一步步走进 kithwood 两树深处与祖先对话，被 Gundobar 当场喝问；她谎称采催孕草药（lady’s mantle）遮掩。
facts.relation: Gundobar 是 Cynghal 法律的看守者（Palati），他憎恶 Tilde，却也怕带着残损的新娘回宫交不了差。
facts.anchor: Gundobar was standing on the road behind me. I was two trunks deep into the kithwood

facts.event: 叛军劫车：箭矢破空，Tilde 拽倒 Hadiah，Gundobar 臂上中箭；约十五名 Merogian 叛军持镰刀、scramasax、木矛冲出林缘，与披甲守卫混战。
facts.relation: 叛军是 Merogian 抵抗者，Tilde 一方是 Cynghal/Galenish 护卫队。
facts.anchor: I grabbed Hadiah’s hand and dragged her to the ground just as arrows hissed overhead

facts.event: 叛军头目钻进车厢，自称知道“真正的古道”（the Ways、druidim），要带 Tilde 入林；Tilde 为不再有失败的叛乱而拒绝救援。
facts.relation: 头目操 Kanaaan 东部口音（与 Sanafin 相同），视 Tilde 为可劫走的公主；Tilde 反视自己为未来的殉道者。
facts.anchor: ‘We don’t need saving,’ I said at last

facts.event: 头目反手扇倒 Tilde，又将 Marolyn 推撞长凳，举青铜镰刀劈下；Tilde 摸出 Marolyn 斗篷里藏的剑往上挡，镰刀砍进剑鞘，Marolyn 随即从颈窝刺入将他杀死。
facts.relation: Marolyn 对 Tilde 的忠诚压过迟疑，第一次真正杀人；此时 Cynghal 甲士破门而入。
facts.anchor: she slammed her knife into the soft crook of his neck

facts.event: Tilde 冲到路上，见六人仍在厮杀，遂发出 Merogian 哭丧的 keening，Marolyn 与 Hadiah 应和；残存叛军遁入林中，她又以“Wing 庇佑此路”的言辞拦住追兵，守卫反高呼“新女王”。
facts.relation: Tilde 以哭丧放走叛军、以神意话术安抚 Cynghal 守卫；母亲的疑虑在她心里生根。
facts.anchor: I let out a cry, a keening, deep and loud.
